annotations.title: Measure a plan, sketch or photo from its points

description: Measures areas, perimeters and lengths from points read off a floor plan, sketch or photo (pixel coordinates) and one known reference (a figured dimension, an ID-1 card or an A4 or Letter sheet): scaled figures in metric and US units with an uncertainty band, closure and crossing checks, and a canvas link. It receives no image.

detail.description: full (the default): the whole answer. summary: the result lines, the citation line and the page only — fewer tokens to read.

inputUnits.description: Send "base" to pass bare numbers on dimensioned inputs in base units (m, m², L, kg …), as the published test vectors are written. Without it a length, area or volume must carry its unit.

pixelError.description: How far any point may be off, in pixels: it sets the band.

reference.description: ONE known size in the same image: a figured dimension, or an object of known size by its four corners.

corners.description: Top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left; the width runs from the first to the second.

items.description: A point in the image's own pixels: x to the right, y down from the top-left corner.

from.description: A point in the image's own pixels: x to the right, y down from the top-left corner.

to.description: A point in the image's own pixels: x to the right, y down from the top-left corner.

tolerance.description: How far the figure itself may be off (a dimension rounded to the nearest 10 mm: 5 mm).

object.description: card: ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 (85.60 × 53.98 mm); a4: 210 × 297 mm; letter: 8.5 × 11 in; custom: width and height given.

shapes.description: The outlines and lines read off the image, in its pixels.

as.description: What it is drawn as on the canvas: a kept measure (the default), or a room (walls round it), slab, floor, patio, deck, driveway, landscaping or roof outline; a fence, footing or retaining wall path. A component is listed with its materials.

calculator.description: A calculator the figure goes into, run on the figure and on both ends of its band (at most 10 per request).

input.description: The id of the calculator's input that takes the figure.

inputs.description: The calculator's input values, by input id (an unknown id is refused with the accepted ids). A length, area, volume or other measured input takes "12 ft", "3.5 m", "8' 3 1/2\"" or {"value": 12, "unit": "ft"}; a count or percentage takes a number; a select takes one of its option values. Inputs left out take the value the calculator's page opens on.

closed.description: A length only: the path closes back to its first point.

kind.description: area: a closed outline (a floor, a slab, a roof plane on plan); length: a line or a path (a fence, a footing, a run).

points.description: In order round the outline or along the path.

items.description: A point in the image's own pixels: x to the right, y down from the top-left corner.

system.description: The unit system inputs left out open in, and the one the page link opens in. The answer comes in both.

name: measure_sketch

anyOf.description: Opens the scaled shapes on the canvas; the drawing rides in the fragment, so nothing is uploaded.

page.description: The site's Photo Takeoff page, whose geometry this is.

notMeasured.description: What the canvas could not measure among the components drawn, and why (a patio, deck or driveway outline that is not square-cornered is drawn, not measured).

citation.description: The one citation line, built from the answer's own data.

lines.description: The result lines, as the report's table gives them.

notes.description: What a professional must decide, when to call one, a false-friend warning, that adoption is local: kept in every summary.
